resolution: PAINTLIVE-0606 landed as 9c38a67fb. The user's ruling ('pick the one where the model can get the live texture') is implemented: a painting saved onto a model bakes each layer's LOOK to a self-contained effect recipe and the model mounts that Effect verbatim — the same shader the painter shows, not a flattened color. editors/paint/surfaces.ts bakeLayerLook() is the one compose authority (packHeaderGrid cols x rows refactor); game/painted.ts adds validated PaintedLayerLook + packPaintedLookData() splicing header(8) ++ dense cell grid ++ colors (malformed look drops to the legacy flat fill, strokes never rejected); paintedRender.tsx mounts the per-layer shader; cutout/models.ts bakes per-layer looks; painted.test.ts + models.test.ts pin the round-trip. framework/gpu/paintable.zig carries the parked-uploads cold-boot fix (pre-mount mask uploads park by key and flush at ensure(), curing the blank-restore race). game/index.ts was deliberately EXCLUDED — its only PAINTLIVE delta is barrel re-exports nothing imports via @game, and it also re-exports an untracked cameraOcclusion module, so committing it whole would open a fresh hole; it stays with the cameraOcclusion/map-pieces lanes. Named riders per BUILDSKIN precedent 5f81e66e4: PAINTLAYERS' 10-shape brush pipeline rides in paintable.zig, and its brushKinds.ts (new file) landed because models.test.ts imports DEFAULT_PAINT_BRUSH_SETTINGS from it. Gate: tools/rjit game verify GREEN 70/70 before commit.
